name: JellyDRTV
description: Puts the whole DRTV catalog into Jellyfin as a normal library. Everything streams straight from DR; download episodes, seasons, series, films and programs you want to keep, and follow series to download new episodes automatically. Only works on a Jellyfin server in Denmark.

versions.changelog: DRM-protected titles are detected and marked: red DRM badge on the poster and a DRM tag (Jellyfin can't play or download them). DRTV badge on all DRTV posters (can be turned off in settings).
Fix playback when Jellyfin runs on another port than 8096 (e.g. Docker on a NAS): Jellyfin's own address is now detected automatically and existing placeholders are updated.
